title: DARPA programs with nine-figure budgets going black to Site 51

tellings.quote: I had a DARPA program manager in here named John Bletch and he didn't say this. This is my speculation, but he kept having these programs in certain cases with nine-figure budgets.

plain: A physicist named John Brandenburg, on podcast host Jesse Michels' show, talks about a program manager at DARPA, the Pentagon's advanced research agency, named John Bletch. Brandenburg says Bletch kept running programs that sometimes had budgets of hundreds of millions of dollars. He is clear that Bletch never said so, but Brandenburg's own guess is that these programs went secret and moved to Area 51, a closely guarded military test site in Nevada.
